_note: Peg-in-hole knobs (FMB board_0 + two pegs on the FR3 cell). Assets: libs/fmb/assets (STEP -> USD with baked PhysX). Dimensions and hole offsets: real2sim/peg_board.py.

board_spawn_z_m._source_detail: Measured foam-mat top (same as the canonical table.top_z_m override). The board USD origin is its bottom face.

peg_spawn_height_above_board_m._source_detail: Scene nominal only; the pregrasp reset event places the peg relative to the hand.

board_mass_measured_kg._source_detail: Weighed. Not used directly: the board uses board_mass_kg below, and the pegs use the mass from the USD density (round 242 g, sqcirc 150 g).

board_mass_kg._source_detail: 7.0x the measured 345 g, a deliberate scale-up in line with the other objects of the cell (pegs 5.6-7.5x, banana 7.1x), so the dynamic board is not pushed by insertion forces.
